name: hexana-vscode-ui-tests
description: Selenium-WebDriver UI acceptance tests for the Hexana VS Code extension

scripts.ui-test: npm run compile && extest get-vscode --code_version max && extest get-chromedriver --code_version max && extest install-vsix --extensions_dir .test-extensions -f ../hexana-wasm-0.0.1.vsix && extest run-tests './out/ui-test/*.test.js' --code_version max --code_settings settings.json --extensions_dir .test-extensions -r fixtures/test-exports.wasm
